name: io.github.BetaNYC/nyc-budget-mcp
title: NYC Budget
description: NYC budget data: Council awards and capital, City agency budgets, OMB capital plan, and CPDB

environmentVariables.name: NYC_BUDGET_PDF_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Set to on to download the checked PDF tables on start if none are installed, or pdfs to also fetch the PDFs

environmentVariables.name: NYC_BUDGET_PDF_DATA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Use another release's PDF-tables manifest instead of the newest release

environmentVariables.name: NYC_BUDGET_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the downloaded PDF tables go (default: a per-user data folder)
